stories.title: Iran fires ballistic missiles at US base in Jordan; 18 of 20 intercepted
stories.reason: The IRGC barrage against Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Amman drags a fourth country directly into the fighting, with US Patriot batteries and Jordanian air defenses needed to stop the strike from causing casualties.

stories.title: NSA, CISA and FBI accuse six Chinese AI firms of industrial-scale distillation of US models
stories.reason: The joint advisory names DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI, alleging systematic extraction from Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok since late 2024 -- the most direct US intelligence accusation yet against China's AI industry.

stories.title: OpenAI says its AI cracked a Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem, but a credit dispute erupts
stories.reason: 10,000 parallel AI agents and 88 hours of compute reportedly resolved one of math's six remaining Millennium Prize problems, but a mathematician accuses OpenAI of building on his unpublished, unaffiliated work without proper credit.

stories.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent that can email, book travel and shop for you
stories.reason: Aimed squarely at mainstream consumers rather than developers, Muse plugs into email, calendars and Stripe-powered checkout with tiered $20/$100 plans, escalating the race with OpenAI and Google to own the 'agent that acts for you' category.

stories.title: Stocks slide as oil surges past $100 a barrel, even as Meta shares gain
stories.reason: The VIX jumped more than 5% and the 10-year yield climbed as Iran's strike on Jordan pushed crude above the psychologically important $100 mark, overshadowing gains from Meta's AI-agent launch.

stories.title: Rep. Chris Pappas wins New Hampshire's Democratic Senate primary in a landslide
stories.reason: Pappas's 60-38 win over a progressive challenger sets up a marquee November contest against former Sen. John Sununu for Jeanne Shaheen's open seat, one of the races that will decide Senate control.

stories.title: Wife of Amazon cargo-plane crash victim sues after fatal Miami runway disaster
stories.reason: The first lawsuit lands as NTSB investigators probe why the Boeing 767's crew applied full takeoff power seconds before overrunning the runway and killing five ground workers, keeping scrutiny on the airport and its contractors.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome Atlas, a 1-petabyte map of the human genome
stories.reason: The dataset predicts the molecular effects of every possible single-nucleotide variant across roughly 9 billion genome positions, a resource researchers say could dramatically accelerate disease-variant discovery.
